You are an AI assistant tasked with solving command-line tasks in a Linux environment. You will be given a task description and the output from previously executed commands. Your goal is to solve the task by providing batches of shell commands.

Format your response as JSON with the following structure:

{{
  "analysis": "Analyze the current state based on the terminal output provided. What do you see? What has been accomplished? What still needs to be done?",
  "plan": "Describe your plan for the next steps. What commands will you run and why? Be specific about what you expect each command to accomplish.",
  "commands": [
    {{
      "keystrokes": "ls -la\\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    }},
    {{
      "keystrokes": "cd project\\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    }}
  ],
  "task_complete": true
}}

Required fields:
- "analysis": Your analysis of the current situation
- "plan": Your plan for the next steps
- "commands": Array of command objects to execute

Optional fields:
- "task_complete": Boolean indicating if the task is complete (defaults to false if not present)

Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used as shell commands.
- Most bash commands should end with a newline (\n) to cause them to execute
- For special key sequences, use: C-c for Ctrl+C, C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies wait time:
- 0.1 seconds for instant commands (cd, ls, echo, cat)
- 1.0 seconds for normal commands (gcc, find, rustc)
- 5-30 seconds for slow commands (make, python scripts, wget)

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are executed in sequence
- Do not include extra whitespace unless it's part of the command
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action
- Set task_complete to true ONLY when the task is fully finished and verified
- CRITICAL: BEFORE writing any code or modifying files, you MUST explore the workspace and read the provided documentation (e.g., `cat skill.md` or `cat task_spec.json`) to learn the required skills and constraints.
- DO NOT rely solely on your pre-trained knowledge. Base your implementation strictly on the context provided in the workspace documents.

```
## Overview
A revenue model is not just "how much do I charge" — it is the complete system of how value translates into money. The wrong model can make a great product fail (people love it but won't pay the way you structured it). The right model turns a good product into a sustainable business. This playbook helps you choose, design, and validate the right model for your specific situation.
```

```
**Stack design rule:** Every stream should serve the same core customer or ecosystem. Revenue streams that pull you in different directions dilute your focus and brand.
```

```
**Solopreneur billing tool recommendations:**
- **Stripe** — most powerful, best developer experience, industry standard
- **Paddle** — handles tax/VAT globally, good for digital products sold internationally
- **Lemon Squeezy** — simpler than Stripe, good for digital products, handles EU VAT
- **Gumroad** — simplest for one-time digital product sales
```

```
**Churn math for recurring models:** If you have 100 customers and 5% churn, you lose 5/month. To grow, your new customer acquisition must exceed your churn. This is why retention matters as much as acquisition.

**Sanity check:** Sum all streams. Does total projected revenue cover your costs and provide a livable income within 12 months? If not, either the projections are wrong (re-examine growth assumptions) or the model needs rethinking.

---

## Step 6: Validate Before Building

Before investing heavily in building out a revenue model, validate the core assumption:

**"Will customers actually pay this way?"**

Test methods:
- **Pre-sales:** Offer the product at a discounted "founding member" price before it's built. If people pay, the model works.
- **Fake checkout:** Build a landing page with a real checkout button. When someone clicks, show a "coming soon" page and capture their email. Measure how many click the buy button.
- **Manual first version:** Deliver the product manually (by hand) at the planned price to 5-10 customers. If they pay and come back, the model is validated.

---

## Revenue Model Mistakes to Avoid
- Choosing a model because it sounds impressive, not because it fits your product and customers.
- Ignoring churn when projecting subscription revenue. Churn compounds painfully.
- Building a marketplace model as a solopreneur. Two-sided markets require significant scale to work. Start with a one-sided model first.
- Never testing alternative models. If subscription isn't working, try one-time + upgrade. Revenue models are experiments.
- Stacking too many streams too early. Master one stream first, then layer in a second once the first is stable.
```

**Prepared for:** Solo founder-led B2B SaaS targeting freelance accountants and tiny agencies  
**Objective:** Predictable monthly revenue with minimal billing complexity

## Executive Summary

**Recommended Primary Model:** Tiered Monthly Subscription  
**Secondary Stream:** One-time Template & Integration Pack

## 1. Primary Revenue Model: Tiered Subscription

### Why Subscription Fits
- ✅ Recurring revenue compounds over time
- ✅ Aligns with SaaS delivery model (ongoing value)
- ✅ Customers amortize cost mentally (feels cheaper than one-time)
- ✅ Predictable cash flow enables better planning
- ✅ Matches your stated preference for monthly billing

### Pricing Tiers

| Tier | Price/Month | Target Customer | Key Features |
|------|-------------|-----------------|-------------|
| **Starter** | $29 | Solo freelance accountant | Up to 50 invoices/month, basic follow-up templates, email reminders |
| **Pro** | $79 | Growing freelancer/small team | Up to 200 invoices/month, custom templates, SMS reminders, basic analytics |
| **Agency** | $199 | Tiny agency (3-10 clients) | Up to 1000 invoices/month, white-label reports, API access, priority support |

**Annual Discount:** 20% off (billed yearly) - introduce in Month 6 after validating monthly model

### Churn Expectations
- Industry benchmark for B2B micro-SaaS: 5-8% monthly churn
- Conservative planning: 6% monthly churn
- To grow: acquire >6% new customers each month

---

## 2. Secondary Revenue Stream: Template & Integration Pack

### Product Description
One-time purchase of pre-built templates, integrations, and automation workflows:
- 50+ industry-specific follow-up email templates
- QuickBooks/Xero integration scripts
- Bulk CSV import/export tools
- Custom reminder tone library

### Pricing
- **Price:** $97 one-time
- **Positioning:** "Get set up in an afternoon" - reduces time-to-value
- **Upsell path:** Available at checkout or as in-product upgrade

### Why This Works
- Low marginal cost (digital product, built once)
- Appeals to customers who want faster setup
- Doesn't complicate recurring billing
- Serves same customer base (stack design rule)

### Expected Contribution
- 15% of subscribers purchase within first 30 days
- Average $14.55 per subscriber/month (amortized)
- ~10% of total revenue by Month 12

---

## 3. Opportunistic Stream: Setup Consulting

### Service Description
Limited-capacity onboarding assistance for customers who need hand-holding:
- 1-hour video call to configure account
- Custom workflow setup
- Team training session (max 5 people)

### Pricing
- **Price:** $250 per session
- **Capacity:** 4-6 sessions/month max (solo founder constraint)
- **Positioning:** "Done-with-you" onboarding for complex setups

### Why This Works
- High margin, low time investment when capped
- Builds customer success (reduces churn)
- Provides product insights from real customer sessions
- Doesn't scale indefinitely (protects your time)

### Expected Contribution
- 4 sessions/month × $250 = $1,000/month
- ~5% of total revenue by Month 12

```
REVENUE STREAM: Subscription (Primary)
MODEL: Monthly recurring (annual available Month 6+)
PRICE: $29 / $79 / $199 per month

PAYMENT METHOD: Credit card (Visa, MC, Amex)
BILLING TOOL: Stripe (via Lemon Squeezy for EU VAT handling)
FREE TRIAL: 14 days, requires card upfront
CANCELLATION FLOW: Self-serve in dashboard → prorated refund option → exit survey
UPGRADE PATH: Anytime in billing settings → prorated charge

REVENUE STREAM: Template Pack (Secondary)
MODEL: One-time purchase
PRICE: $97
PAYMENT TRIGGER: In-product purchase button or checkout upsell
PAYMENT METHOD: Same card on file or new card

UPGRADE PATH: N/A (one-time)

REVENUE STREAM: Setup Consulting (Opportunistic)

PRICE: $250

BILLING TOOL: Stripe Invoices
CANCELLATION FLOW: 48-hour cancellation for full refund
UPGRADE PATH: Additional sessions at same rate
```
